unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.intro: You can stop receiving marketing communications at any time, free of charge and immediately (Peruvian Personal Data Protection Law 29733).
unsubscribe.legend: What do you want to unsubscribe from?
unsubscribe.transactional: You will keep receiving the emails needed for your bookings (confirmations, vouchers and payment notices).
unsubscribe.nothingActive: You are no longer subscribed to marketing communications with this email. You don't need to do anything else.

errors.incomplete: The unsubscribe link is incomplete. Open it directly from our email.
errors.invalidLink: The link is not valid. Use the most recent link from our emails.
errors.noneSelected: Select at least one channel to unsubscribe from.
errors.tampered: The unsubscribe link is not valid or was modified. Use the most recent link from our emails.
errors.busy: You made several attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: We could not process the request right now. Try again in a few minutes or contact us.
errors.loadFailed: We could not load your preferences right now. Try again in a few minutes.

confirm.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: without your confirmation we will not send you advertising.
confirm.alreadyConfirmed: Your subscription is already confirmed. You don't need to do anything else.
confirm.nothingToConfirm: There is no subscription pending confirmation with this link.
